### Observed differences

- In the earlier window, A26, A27 and A28 each ran in every trace (200 of 200, about one occurrence per trace, around 37% of the trace's length); in the later window they appear in only about 2 in 100 traces. [OCC005, OCC006, OCC007, POS004, POS005, POS006]
- A19, A20 and A21 were almost absent earlier (1–2 in 100 traces) and now each runs in about 30–38 in 100 traces, at a tightly concentrated position around 36% of the trace, whereas their few earlier occurrences sat at scattered positions. The three never share a trace (cooccurrence 0 in both windows), so they behave as mutually exclusive alternatives. [OCC002, OCC003, OCC004, POS001, POS002, POS003, REL013, REL014, REL021]
- A44's outgoing transitions were rewired: earlier about 82% of its observed transitions went to A26, A27 or A28 (roughly 25–28% each); later about 79% go to A19, A20 or A21 (roughly 25–27% each). [DIR007]
- A19, A20 and A21 now lead almost exclusively to A29 (about 95 in 100 of their observed outgoing transitions); their rare earlier occurrences (2–4 traces) showed other successors. [DIR001, DIR002, DIR003]
- The new activities sit between A44 and A29: in the later window A44 precedes A19, A20 or A21 in about 30–37 in 100 traces, and the chosen activity precedes A29 in about 30–37 in 100 — essentially every trace in which that activity occurs. Earlier, A19/A20/A21 co-occurred with A29 in only about 2 in 100 traces. [REL018, REL019, REL025, REL026, REL032, REL033]
- The event distance from A44 to A29 shrank: earlier mostly 4–5 steps (about 78 in 100 at distance 4), later mostly 2–3 steps (about 79 in 100 at distance 2), consistent with three intermediate activities being replaced by one. [LAG009]
- The old block's relations disappeared: A26, A27 and A28 co-occurred in 100 of 100 earlier traces in mixed order (both orders in similar proportions), each preceded A29 in about 97–99 in 100 traces, and A44 preceded them in about 97–99 in 100; in the later window their pairwise cooccurrence is about 1 in 100 and A29 almost always occurs without them. [REL036, REL037, REL042, REL038, REL039, REL043, REL047, REL048]

### Inference

Support level: Supported hypothesis

The evidence supports the possibility that the mandatory segment between A44 and A29 changed structurally: instead of always executing the three activities A26, A27 and A28 together (in varying order) between A44 and A29, traces in the later window execute exactly one of the three mutually exclusive alternatives A19, A20 or A21, which then leads on to A29 [OCC005, OCC006, OCC007, OCC002, OCC003, OCC004, REL013, REL014, REL021, DIR007, DIR001, DIR002, DIR003, REL018, REL019, REL025, REL026, REL032, REL033, LAG009]. The signs are direct and consistent: A44 now points to A19/A20/A21 instead of A26/A27/A28; the new activities lead to A29 in about 95 in 100 of their observed transitions; A44 precedes and A29 follows the chosen activity in essentially every trace where it occurs; the A44-to-A29 distance contracted from 4–5 to 2–3 steps; and A29's and A44's mean positions shifted only slightly (about 0.44 to 0.40 and 0.31 to 0.33), as expected for a shorter intermediate segment [POS007, POS008]. With 81 qualifying items against fewer than 1 expected for an unchanged process (control-flow family), the overall volume also far exceeds what random re-splits produce.

Limitations: the earlier-window behaviour of A19, A20 and A21 rests on only 2–4 traces, so their pre-change routing is essentially unobserved; the evidence cannot distinguish a genuine replacement of activities from the same work appearing under different labels; and the old block still shows up in about 2 in 100 later traces, so it may persist as a rare path [DIR001, DIR002, DIR003, OCC005, OCC006, OCC007].

Other differences:
- A10's participation rose from about 14 in 100 to about 23 in 100 traces. [OCC001]
- A11 and A12, which earlier co-occurred with A26/A27/A28 in about 46–47 in 100 traces (usually before them), now precede A19/A20/A21 in about 16–21 in 100 traces. [REL001, REL002, REL003, REL004, REL005, REL006, REL007, REL008, REL009, REL010, REL011, REL012]
- A20 and A21 now co-occur with A46 in about 22–27 in 100 traces, whereas A26/A27/A28 previously co-occurred with A46 in about 59 in 100. [REL028, REL035, REL041, REL046, REL050]

Let me analyse this evidence carefully.

We have two windows of 200 traces each. Screening: 178 units tested, 81 items qualified, 0.89 expected without change. So 81 items vs 0.89 expected — the count is many times larger than the chance expectation. This is a massive excess, so the screening comparison does not lead to "insufficient evidence". All items are control-flow family (no time or resource items — no TWAIT, ASSIGN, CONC, HAND indicators). So I should not discuss time or resources.

All items have empirical_strength ~0.995, which is high, but that alone doesn't separate real change from rare variants. The key is the count: 81 items vs 0.89 expected — many times larger. So we proceed to judge by directness, consistency, and ability to rule out competing explanations.

Let me now understand the behavioural story.

OCC items:
- OCC001: A10 — participation 13.5% → 22.5%, mean occurrences 0.14 → 0.26. Support 27 → 45. Increased.
- OCC002: A19 — participation 2% → 30%, mean 0.02 → 0.305. Support 4 → 60. Increased.
- OCC003: A20 — participation 1.5% → 32.5%, mean 0.015 → 0.335. Support 3 → 65. Increased.
- OCC004: A21 — participation 1% → 37.5%, mean 0.01 → 0.38. Support 2 → 75. Increased.
- OCC005: A26 — participation 100% → 1.5%, mean 1.02 → 0.015. Support 200 → 3. Decreased (essentially disappeared).
- OCC006: A27 — participation 100% → 1.5%. Decreased (disappeared).
- OCC007: A28 — participation 100% → 1.5%. Decreased (disappeared).

So A26, A27, A28 were in every trace before and virtually disappeared after. A19, A20, A21 were nearly absent before and now appear in ~30-37.5% of traces. A10 increased modestly (13.5% → 22.5%).

DIR items:
- DIR001: A19's outgoing transitions. Before (support 4 traces): A34 25%, A39 25%, A11 50%. After (support 61): A29 ~95%, A36/A12/A42 ~1.6% each. So A19 now almost always leads to A29.
- DIR002: A20's outgoing. Before (3 traces): A08, A11, A47 each ~33%. After (67): A29 ~95.5%, A44 ~3%, A30 ~1.5%. A20 now leads to A29.
- DIR003: A21's outgoing. Before (2 traces): A34 50%, A36 50%. After (76): A29 ~94.7%, plus small others. A21 now leads to A29.
- DIR004: A26's outgoing. Before (203 transitions): spread over A29 (34%), A28 (29%), A27 (33%), plus small. After (3 transitions): A27, A20, A43 each 33%. A26 nearly gone.
- DIR005: A27's outgoing. Before: A26 27.6%, A29 35%, A28 34.5%, small others. After (3): A29, A05, A37 each 33%.
- DIR006: A28's outgoing. Before: A26 35.5%, A27 34.5%, A29 27.5%, A10 1%. After (3): A26, A07, A24 each 33%.
- DIR007: A44's outgoing. Before (201): A28 28%, A27 25%, A26 28%, small others. After (202): A21 27%, A20 27%, A19 25%, small others. So A44 now leads to A19/A20/A21 instead of A26/A27/A28. This is a big structural shift: A44's successors changed from the {A26, A27, A28} group to the {A19, A20, A21} group.

POS items:
- POS001-003: A19, A20, A21 positions. Before rare (support 2-4%), positions scattered (median ~0.7-0.76 for A19/A20, high std). After: support 30-37.5%, positions concentrated around 0.36 (median ~0.36, std ~0.06). So they now occur consistently at about a third into the trace.
- POS004-006: A26, A27, A28 positions. Before support 100%, mean ~0.37-0.38. After support 1.5%. So they used to occur at ~0.37 position in every trace; now virtually absent.
- POS007: A29 — support 100% both windows, mean position 0.437 → 0.400. Slight shift earlier.
- POS008: A44 — support 100% both, mean 0.309 → 0.330. Slight shift later.

REL items — many. Let me group:

REL001-003 (A11 with A19/A20/A21) and REL007-009 (A12 with A19/A20/A21): Before, A11/A12 occur in ~46-47% of traces (A_only), the new activities rarely; cooccurrence ~0-1.5%. After: cooccurrence 16.5-21.5%, A_before_B 16-21%, B_only 12.5-16.5%. So A19/A20/A21 now often follow A11/A12 (A_before_B means A11 before A19). Actually "A_before_B" with A=A11, B=A19: A11 before A19 in ~16.5% of traces after, vs ~0.5% before. So A19/A20/A21 typically come after A11/A12.

REL004-006 (A11 with A26/A27/A28): Before, cooccurrence 46.5%, B_only 53.5%, A_before_B ~46% (A11 before A26). After: cooccurrence ~1%, A_only 57%, neither ~41.5%. So A11 and A26/A27/A28 used to co-occur (A11 before A26 in ~46% of traces); now they almost never co-occur.

REL010-012 (A12 with A26/A27/A28): same pattern. Before cooccurrence 47%, A_before_B ~46.5%. After cooccurrence ~1%.

REL013-014 (A19 with A20, A19 with A21): Before, neither 96.5-97.5% (both rare). After: A_only 30%, B_only 32.5-37.5%, neither 32.5-37.5%, cooccurrence 0. - LAG002 (A26→A29): before gaps 1-3; after support 3. Weak.
- LAG003 (A27→A29): before gaps 1-3; after support 1.

This is consistent with the block A26/A27/A28 (three activities between A44 and A29) being removed: previously A44 → A26/A27/A28 (3 activities) → A29, giving gap 4; now A44 → A19/A20/A21 (one activity) → A29, giving gap 2. This LAG009 item has strong support in both windows (195 and 200) and directly shows the structural change.

Now the overall story:

Before: Every trace contained A26, A27, A28 (each 100% participation, ~1 occurrence each), positioned around 0.37 of the trace. A44 (100%) led into this block (A44 → A26/A27/A28 in ~97.5-99.5% of traces), and the block led to A29 (A26/A27/A28 → A29 in ~97.5-99.5%). So the hypothesis: the block of three always-executed activities A26, A27, A28 between A44 and A29 was replaced by a single choice of one of three alternatives A19, A20, A21 (each ~30-37.5% of traces, mutually exclusive), which then lead to A29.
